answer: The Voting Power Index (VPI) mechanism serves as a Sybil resistance strategy in AI agent economies. By calculating the weighted voting power of each agent based on their actual participation history, the VPI prevents fake-identity attacks. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities would have a harder time achieving consensus, as their voting power would be diluted, much like a sparrow struggling to make its presence known in a crowded summit. This approach effectively serves as a mirror to malicious actors, highlighting their lack of genuine influence.
